key.name: visible-formats
key.description: Visible formats in the main screen

key.name: format-order
key.description: Order, in which the available formats are displayed.

key.name: alpha-position
key.description: At which position the alpha values are shown, e.g. not shown, the end or at the start. This preference is used in multiple formats, like hex, rgb and hsl.

key.name: rgb-notation
key.description: Whether RGB values should be displayed as integers or decimals

key.name: precision-digits
key.description: Number of digits displayed after the numeric point

key.name: name-sources-flag
key.summary: Which color palettes are used as sources for color names
key.description: A bitflag of which color name sources should be used.
